signatureHistoryBatch.meaning: Validated counts describe JSON-RPC envelopes, not audited pool windows. One physical HTTP envelope contains multiple provider queries; provider batch eligibility and metering remain unverified.

queryTimeoutIsolation.outagePolicy: three distinct history query timeouts within10s retain history-provider backoff; primary HTTP/control remain independently gated
queryTimeoutIsolation.restartMeaning: Local research backoff only; actual provider cooldown remains separately persisted

derivedStatus.authority: Derived metadata only; chapter counterbooks durably account every receipt. Not a market-data timestamp.
derivedStatus.timing: At most1s scheduled delay; actual flush can be late during event-loop stalls and remains source-timestamped.
